slug: 真心待你反被弃转娶圣女你悔啥
lines: read2（）;紫阳峰外，一道熟悉的倩影满脸怒色，叉腰喝骂。
“林子衿？”
辰南眉头微皱。
他已经休妻，与林家再无关系，林子衿来干什么？
“姓辰的，没想到你竟然如此卑鄙，故意挑拨药长老，让她不给我母亲治病，你这是要害死我母亲吗？”
“我姐当初真是瞎了眼，怎么会看上你这么一个卑鄙无耻的小人？”
“你今天要是不给我一个交代，我便让整个圣地的人都知道你的恶毒行径。”
林子衿冲到辰南面前，一副趾高气昂，嚣张跋扈的模样。
“药长老？”
辰南疑惑不解。
林母心脏有疾，辰南刚娶林轻眉的时候就已经很严重了。
是辰南靠着父亲的恩情，请圣地第一炼丹师的药长老出手医治，并且每日服用心脉丹，这才稳住病情，保住性命。
“装，你还装！”
“谁不知道你父亲当初救过药长老一命，所以药长老才对你照顾有加。”
“要不是你挑拨，药长老怎么可能不给我母亲治病，甚至连心脉丹都不给了。”
“我姐亲自去请，药长老却是连见都不见。”
“姓辰的，你敢做不敢当，算什么男人？”
林子衿破口大骂。
啪！
就在此时，一道身影快逾闪电，出现在林子衿身前，旋即一巴掌抽出，精准的打在林子衿的脸上。
这一巴掌直接将林子衿抽倒在地，脸颊高肿，血水横流，惨不忍睹。
“谁给你的胆子，敢辱骂家主！”
李青山厉声呵斥，归一境的强大气息压得林子衿脸色煞白，再无之前的嚣张跋扈。
辰南看了李青山一眼。
这个李叔，并不像表面看上去那么敦厚老实。
不过这一巴掌，却是很爽。
“李叔，将她扔出去。”
“以后这种阿猫阿狗，不能让他们脏了我紫阳峰的空气。”
辰南懒得解释。
他和林家已经恩断义绝，至于药长老的态度，辰南也能够猜得到。
一开始药长老便提醒过他，说林家都是一群白眼狼。
如今辰南休妻，离开了林家，药长老自然不会再去给林母治病。
药长老用实际行动在替辰南鸣不平，这份恩情，辰南记在了心里。
“是，家主！”
李青山恭声应答，便要将林子衿扔出去。
“姓辰的，你只会借助外物狐假虎威吗？”
“有本事你不用圣主令，与我公平一战，我今天不将你打得满地找牙，我就不姓林！”

read2(); Outside Ziyang Peak, a familiar figure had an angry look on her face, her hands on her hips and she was shouting curses.
"Lin Zijin?"
Chen Nan frowned slightly.
He has divorced his wife and has no relationship with the Lin family anymore. What is Lin Zijin doing here?
"Chen, I didn't expect you to be so despicable. You deliberately provoked Elder Yao to prevent her from treating my mother. Are you trying to kill my mother?"
"My sister was really blind back then. How could she fall in love with such a despicable and shameless person like you?"
"If you don't give me an explanation today, I will let the entire Holy Land know about your vicious behavior."
Lin Zijin rushed to Chen Nan, looking arrogant and domineering.
"Elder Yao?"
Chen Nan was puzzled.
Lin's mother had a heart disease, which was already serious when Chen Nan first married Lin Qingmei.
It was Chen Nan who relied on his father's kindness to ask Elder Yao, the number one alchemist in the Holy Land, to treat him. He also took Xinmai Dan every day, which stabilized his condition and saved his life.
"Pretend, you're still pretending!"
"Who doesn't know that your father saved Elder Yao's life, so Elder Yao takes good care of you."
"If it weren't for your instigation, how could Elder Yao not treat my mother's illness, or even give her the Heart Pulse Pill."
"My sister went to invite her personally, but Elder Yao didn't even see her."
"Chen, whether you dare to do it or not, what kind of man do you think you are?"
Lin Zijin cursed loudly.
Snap!
At this moment, a figure, faster than lightning, appeared in front of Lin Zijin, and immediately slapped Lin Zijin in the face with precision.
This slap directly knocked Lin Zijin to the ground. His cheek was swollen and blood was flowing horizontally. It was terrible to see.
"Who gave you the courage to insult the master of the family!"
Li Qingshan scolded him sternly, and the powerful aura of Guiyi Realm made Lin Zijin's face turn pale, and he no longer looked as arrogant and domineering as before.
Chen Nan glanced at Li Qingshan.
This Uncle Li is not as honest and honest as he seems on the surface.
But this slap was very satisfying.
"Uncle Li, throw her out."
"From now on, cats and dogs like this can't be allowed to pollute the air in our Ziyang Peak."
Chen Nan was too lazy to explain.
He and the Lin family have severed all ties. As for Elder Yao's attitude, Chen Nan can also guess.
Elder Yao had reminded him from the beginning that the Lin family were all a bunch of white-eyed wolves.
Now that Chen Nan has divorced his wife and left the Lin family, Elder Yao will naturally no longer treat Mother Lin.
Elder Yao used practical actions to defend Chen Nan, and Chen Nan kept this kindness in his heart.
"Yes, head of the family!"
Li Qingshan responded respectfully and was about to throw Lin Zijin out.
"Chen, can you only use foreign objects to fake the power of a tiger?"
"If you have the ability, you don't need the Holy Lord's order to give me a fair fight. If I don't beat you to pieces today, my surname will not be Lin!"
